fields.value: No fixed end date; ends on the 60th day after written termination notice or upon termination of the applicable Distribution Agreement for a Fund.

quotes.text:
The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall end on the 60th day following a
written notice from one party to the other of its decision to terminate this Agreement at the end of such 60-day period or upon termination of the
applicable Distribution Agreement with respect to a Fund.

Termination of this Agreement as to a Fund shall not terminate this Agreement with
respect to any other Fund so long as such other Fund’s (or Funds’, as the case may be) Distribution Agreement is effective. If this Agreement is
terminated by one party, it shall terminate the entire Agreement.

ambiguities: Clause 4. Duration and Termination. does not identify any date of termination notice or Distribution Agreement termination, so no YYYY-MM-DD end date can be calculated.
Clause 4. Duration and Termination. distinguishes termination as to a Fund from termination of the entire Agreement, so the end may differ by Fund unless one party terminates the entire Agreement.

fields.value: Either party may terminate the entire Agreement on 60 days' written notice.

(c) Any and all claims, losses, cost or expenses shall be limited to actual and direct costs. In no event shall any party be

ambiguities: Clause 7. Indemnification. limits categories of recoverable damages but does not state a single monetary ceiling or aggregate cap.

payments.description: ALPS or its designated agent, at each Fund's direction, will facilitate payment of the applicable dealer reallowance fee / compensation to S2K.
payments.conditionNote: Amount depends on each Fund's then-current Prospectus and class-by-class basis; no compensation is due until Distributor actually receives payments from the Fund; facilitation ceases for the applicable Fund when the 8.0% threshold is reached.

quotes.text:
(a) As described in the Fund’s Prospectus, the Fund may impose a sales charge “load” in connection with the purchase of shares
of the Fund, a portion of which will be paid to S2K pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Prospectus.

(b) In consideration of the marketing, sales and other related activities provided by S2K, the Distributor may compensate S2K for
such services on each Fund’s behalf and at the direction of each such Fund. The amount of compensation payable by the Distributor to S2K
hereunder shall be determined on a class by class basis. At the direction of each Fund, ALPS or its designated agent will facilitate the payment of
the applicable dealer reallowance fee to S2K in the amounts set forth in Exhibit B hereto.

(c) No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments
from such Fund, to the extent applicable.

At the direction of each Fund set forth in Exhibit A to this Agreement, ALPS or its designated agent will facilitate the payment of the applicable
dealer reallowance fee to S2K (as a percentage of the offering price) in the amounts set forth in each such Fund’s then-current Prospectus.

In no event will a Fund’s aggregate selling commissions, dealer manager fees and distribution and servicing fees, if applicable, exceed 8.0% of the
aggregate gross proceeds raised in the Fund’s offering. Therefore, the Distributor’s facilitation of the dealer reallowance payments set forth in each
Fund’s then-current Prospectus shall cease with respect to the applicable Fund as of the date such 8.0% threshold has been reached with respect
to such Fund.

ambiguities: Section 5. Compensation; Expenses and Exhibit B do not state a fixed amount; they refer to each Fund’s then-current Prospectus and a class-by-class determination.
Section 5(c) makes payment dependent on Distributor actually receiving payments from the applicable Fund, and no due date is stated.

payments.description: S2K must reimburse Distributor for reasonable out-of-pocket expenses, including FINRA advertising/filing fees and expedited review fees.
payments.conditionNote: Applies as reasonable out-of-pocket expenses are incurred; the agreement does not state a payment date.

quotes.text:
(e) S2K shall reimburse Distributor for all reasonable out-of-pocket expenses, including but not limited to: FINRA
advertising/filing fees (including additional fees for expedited reviews as set forth in Section 2(b) herein).

ambiguities: Section 5(e) does not state the amount of reimbursable expenses or when reimbursement is due.

payments.description: S2K is charged $250 for each expedited review request, in addition to FINRA filing fees, unless Distributor fails to provide comments within one business day.
payments.conditionNote: Only applies if S2K requests expedited review through AdLit and accepts the related terms and fees; the charge does not apply if Distributor fails to provide comments within one business day.

quotes.text: a) A charge of $250 will apply to each request for expedited review, in addition to FINRA filing fees.

d) S2K must check the box on the AdLit coversheet whereby S2K requests and accepts the terms and fee(s) associated
with expedited review in order to ensure that Distributor is notified of the expedited request.

If Distributor fails to provide S2K with
comments within one business day, the $250 expedited review charge will not apply.

ambiguities: Section 2(b)(iv) states the amount and trigger for the charge, but does not state when it must be paid.

payments.description: S2K bears all expenses and costs attributable to producing, reviewing, approving, using and filing Fund Materials.
payments.conditionNote: Applies if S2K produces Fund Materials for use in marketing a Fund; the agreement does not state a fixed amount or payment date.

quotes.text: S2K shall be entitled to produce materials ( “ Fund Materials ” ) for use in marketing a Fund as described herein

All expenses and costs attributable to the
foregoing provision shall be borne by S2K in accordance with Section 2 and Section 5 herein.

ambiguities: Section 9. Fund Materials. does not state the amount of Fund Materials expenses or when they must be paid.
